import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        
        long bestNum = -1;
        long bestDen = 0;
        long i = 1;
        
        while (i <= n) {
            long cand = (i * x) / y;
            if ((i * x - cand * y) > ((cand + 1) * y - i * x)) {
                cand++;
            }
            
            if (bestNum == -1 ||
                (Math.abs(cand * y - i * x) * bestDen) < (Math.abs(bestNum * y - bestDen * x) * i)) {
                bestNum = cand;
                bestDen = i;
            }
            
            i++;
        }
        
        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
    }
}
